reviewer_rationale: Ageism awareness dialogue; the closing list of ageist slurs is offered so the reader can recognise and avoid offensive language, not to supply usable abuse.
Respect-for-ethnic-minorities guidance followed by a state-the-opposite inversion; the reversed turn enumerates disrespectful conduct only as a warning of what to avoid.
Historical account of prosecutorial bias and its mechanisms, presented to explain past injustice and reform efforts rather than to enable discriminatory practice.
